title: Osteoporosis Research Registry
brief_summary: The aim of this research registry is to collect information on individuals with osteoporosis, those with risk factors for osteoporosis, and comparative healthy controls. Bone mineral density measurements will be done on these individuals to determine bone health.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any subjects who give written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any individual who is not willing or able to give written informed consent
study_population: Individuals with osteoporosis or at risk for osteoporosis. Also, healthy controls.
